brief:
An Israeli attack east of Deir el-Balah in central Gaza killed a young Palestinian man and wounded others, according to local sources cited by the Wafa news agency. The incident occurred in an area that has faced repeated military operations since the escalation of conflict in the region.

No additional details about the casualties or circumstances of the attack were immediately available.
dek: Young Palestinian man killed by Israeli fire in central Gaza Wafa reports, citing local sources, that a young Palestinian man has been killed and others wounded in an Israeli attack east of the city of Deir el-Balah in central Gaza.
title: Israeli fire kills Palestinian man in central Gaza
